How We Work

From Inquiry to Delivery

A transparent, six-step process designed for international buyers.

01

Inquiry

Share product, quantity, destination, and specifications.

02

Quotation

Receive pricing with applicable Incoterms and commercial terms.

03

Sampling

Samples arranged for quality verification when required.

04

Order Confirmation

Order confirmed with agreed payment and delivery terms.

05

QC & Shipping

Quality checks, documentation, and shipment coordination.

06

Delivery & After-Sales

Delivery confirmation and ongoing after-sales communication.

Incoterms Explained

Choose the term that fits your logistics and risk preference.

IncotermMeaningBest For
EXWEx Works — buyer collects from our facilityBuyers with own logistics
FOBFree On Board — we deliver to portBuyers arranging own shipping
CFRCost & Freight — we cover freight to destination portBuyers wanting landed port price
CIFCost, Insurance & Freight — we cover freight + insuranceBuyers wanting full coverage
Secure Commercial Payments

Bank Transfer & Payment

For your protection, complete bank details are shared only through our official Quotation or Proforma Invoice (PI).

How to Receive Bank Details

  1. Request a formal quotation or PIFrom our sales team via email or WhatsApp.
  2. Verify the account titleIt must read "ALI ENTERPRISES".
  3. Confirm the PI reference numberIt should match your order confirmation.
🏦 Bank Transfer (TT)📄 Letter of Credit (L/C) — on request

⚠️ Payment Safety Notice

Never share passwords, PINs, or card security codes. Ali Enterprises will never ask for these. Always verify bank details against our official Proforma Invoice before sending funds.

About Ali Enterprises

A Pakistan-Based Trading & Sourcing Partner

Ali Enterprises is an FBR-registered Pakistani trading company established in October 2016. We facilitate trade between Pakistan and international markets by connecting buyers with verified local suppliers through transparent sourcing, competitive pricing, and reliable logistics coordination.

✓
Verified Supply Access

Direct access to Pakistani manufacturers and suppliers across multiple product categories.

📋
Transparent Quotations

Clear commercial terms and applicable Incoterms including FOB, CIF, CFR, and EXW.

🌐
International Communication

English-speaking sales and support for cross-border enquiries and coordination.

📑
Documentation Compliance

Full export documentation support — invoice, packing list, BL, COO, and certifications.

"Since 2016, we have built Ali Enterprises on a simple principle: treat every buyer's order as if it were our own. Whether you need a single container of textiles or a custom-sourced industrial component, we handle the process with transparency, speed, and accountability."

Ali AhsanFounder, Ali Enterprises
